title: Inter-patient ECG Arrhythmia Classification with LGNs and LUTNs
abstract: arXiv:2601.11433v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep Differentiable Logic Gate Networks (LGNs) and Lookup Table Networks (LUTNs) are demonstrated to be suitable for the automatic classification of electrocardiograms (ECGs) using the inter-patient paradigm. The methods are benchmarked using the MIT-BIH arrhythmia data set, achieving up to 94.28% accuracy and a $j\kappa$ index of 0.683 on a four-class classification problem. Our models use between 2.89k and 6.17k FLOPs, including preprocessing and readout, which is three to six orders of magnitude less compared to SOTA methods. A novel preprocessing method is utilized that attains superior performance compared to existing methods for both the mixed-patient and inter-patient paradigms. In addition, a novel method for training the Lookup Tables (LUTs) in LUTNs is devised that uses the Boolean equation of a multiplexer (MUX). translated_title: 基于逻辑门网络（LGNs）和查找表网络（LUTNs）的患者间心电图心律失常分类
translated_abstract: 深度可微分逻辑门网络（LGNs）和查找表网络（LUTNs）被证明适用于采用患者间范式的心电图（ECG）自动分类。这些方法在MIT-BIH心律失常数据集上进行了基准测试，在四分类问题上达到了高达94.28%的准确率和0.683的jκ指数。我们的模型（包括预处理和读出部分）仅使用2.89k至6.17k的FLOPs，比最先进的（SOTA）方法少三到六个数量级。我们采用了一种新颖的预处理方法，在混合患者和患者间两种范式下均取得了优于现有方法的性能。此外，还设计了一种利用多路复用器（MUX）布尔方程来训练LUTNs中查找表（LUT）的新方法。另外，首次在这些LGNs和LUTNs中采用了速率编码，从而提升了性能。
tldr: 本文首次将可微分逻辑门网络（LGNs）和查找表网络（LUTNs）应用于患者间心电图心律失常分类，结合新型预处理方法、基于多路复用器布尔方程的LUT训练方法以及速率编码，在MIT-BIH数据集上以仅2.89k至6.17k FLOPs的超低计算量（比SOTA方法少三到六个数量级）达到94.28%的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that differentiable logic gate networks (LGNs) and lookup table networks (LUTNs) can achieve 94.28% accuracy on inter-patient ECG arrhythmia classification using only 2.89k–6.17k FLOPs—three to six orders of magnitude less than SOTA methods—leveraging a novel preprocessing method, MUX-based LUT training, and rate coding.
